task.title: Configuring Sleep Mode Timers on HP DesignJet Z6/Z9+

taskbody.p: This task describes how to configure the sleep mode timers on the HP DesignJet Z6/Z9+ printer series to optimize energy efficiency and ensure quick response times.

step.info: The front panel is a touch-sensitive screen located on the front right of the printer.

step.cmd: Tap the System icon on the front panel.
step.info: This will open the system settings menu where various printer options can be configured.

step.cmd: Select Power options from the menu.
step.info: Here you can adjust settings related to the printer's power management.
You can set the sleep mode timer from 5 to 240 minutes. The default time is 20 minutes, which includes 5 minutes in dim mode.

step.cmd: Adjust the timer to your preferred setting.
step.info: Use the slider or input field to set the desired time before the printer enters sleep mode.

step.cmd: Confirm your selection and exit the menu.
step.info: The printer will now enter sleep mode after the specified period of inactivity.

taskbody.note: It is recommended to leave the printer powered on or in sleep mode to avoid wasting ink and time due to long preparation times after idle periods.
Ensure that the printer is not set to power off automatically if you require it to remain connected to the network for remote management tasks.
